rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken Cantonese way to say that someone expresses themselves fluently, especially in a language.

example.english: They speak English much more fluently than I do.
example.traditional: 佢英文講得流利過我好多。
example.jyutping: keoi5 jing1 man4 gong2 dak1 lau4 lei6 gwo3 ngo5 hou2 do1
